description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 21.12.2020 to 27.12.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and contains regulatory content specifying new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges.
